figurative_meaning_bn: জোর করে খরচ করতে বাধ্য করা
figurative_meaning_en: To force someone else to bear the expense
similar_in_english: To stick someone with the bill
To pass the buck on expenses
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় পরের ঘাড় ভাঙে, নিজে কখনো খরচ করে না।
পার্টির খরচটা পরের ঘাড় ভাঙার মতো করে তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always breaks someone else's neck, never spending his own money.
The party expenses were foisted on others like breaking their necks.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural attitudes towards selfishness in sharing costs.
